input.command: cat set_environment.sh; ls -R bin configs | head -60; ls -R data | head -40; ls src; cat bin/run.sh; cat configs/cdr/relex/cdr_2500
cat bin/process_CDR/process_CDR.sh; ls data/embeddings; ls src/processing src/models src/evaluation
grep -rEn "openai|tweepy|boto3|api_key|API_KEY|requests\.get" src bin | head; cp -r . /tmp/bran && chmod -R u+w /tmp/bran && echo copied; docker pull tensorflow/tensorflow:1.0.1 2>&1 | tail -3
cd /tmp/bran && grep -rhE "^import|^from" src/processing/utils/process_CDR_data.py src/processing/labled_tsv_to_tfrecords.py src/train_multiclass_classifier.py | sort -u

docker run --rm -v /tmp/bran:/repo -w /repo -e CDR_IE_ROOT=/repo -e PYTHONPATH=/repo tensorflow/tensorflow:1.0.1 bash -c "pip install -q nltk 2>&1|tail -3; python -c 'import nltk;nltk.download(\"punkt\")' 2>&1|tail -2; timeout 600 bash bin/process_CDR/process_CDR.sh 2>&1 | tail -30"

docker run --rm -v /tmp/bran:/repo -w /repo tensorflow/tensorflow:1.0.1 bash -c "pip install --index-url=https://pypi.org/simple --trusted-host pypi.org --trusted-host files.pythonhosted.org 'nltk==3.4.5' 2>&1 | tail -5"

mkdir -p /tmp/whl && cd /tmp/whl && curl -sL -o nltk.zip https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/f6/1d/d8c0f0c63de3a1cb4e01f1a3312a197b2b4a5bf0d7b9c4dbfb0a0a1dbb0a/nltk-3.4.5.zip; ls -la; pip download nltk==3.4.5 --no-deps -d /tmp/whl 2>&1|tail -2

cd /tmp/whl && rm nltk.zip && pip download six -d /tmp/whl --no-deps 2>&1|tail -1; curl -sL -o /tmp/whl/punkt.zip https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nltk/nltk_data/gh-pages/packages/tokenizers/punkt.zip; ls -la /tmp/whl

docker run --rm -v /tmp/bran:/repo -v /tmp/whl:/whl:ro -w /repo -e CDR_IE_ROOT=/repo -e PYTHONPATH=/repo tensorflow/tensorflow:1.0.1 bash -c "
pip install --no-index /whl/six-1.17.0-py2.py3-none-any.whl /whl/nltk-3.4.5.zip 2>&1|tail -2
mkdir -p /usr/share/nltk_data/tokenizers && cd /usr/share/nltk_data/tokenizers && unzip -q /whl/punkt.zip && cd /repo
python -c 'from nltk.tokenize import sent_tokenize; print(sent_tokenize(\"Hi there. Bye.\"))'
timeout 900 bash bin/process_CDR/process_CDR.sh 2>&1 | tail -15
ls /repo/data/cdr/processed/just_train_2500/protos | head -20"

docker run --rm -v /tmp/bran:/repo -v /tmp/whl:/whl:ro -w /repo -e CDR_IE_ROOT=/repo -e PYTHONPATH=/repo tensorflow/tensorflow:1.0.1 bash -c "
pip install --no-index --no-deps /whl/nltk-3.4.5.zip 2>&1|tail -2
mkdir -p /usr/share/nltk_data/tokenizers && cd /usr/share/nltk_data/tokenizers && unzip -q /whl/punkt.zip && cd /repo
python -c 'from nltk.tokenize import sent_tokenize; print(sent_tokenize(\"Hi there. Bye.\"))'
timeout 900 bash bin/process_CDR/process_CDR.sh 2>&1 | tail -8
ls /repo/data/cdr/processed/just_train_2500/protos"

docker run --rm -v /tmp/bran:/repo -v /tmp/whl:/whl:ro -w /repo -e CDR_IE_ROOT=/repo -e PYTHONPATH=/repo tensorflow/tensorflow:1.0.1 bash -c "
pip install -q --no-index --no-deps /whl/nltk-3.4.5.zip >/dev/null 2>&1
mkdir -p /usr/share/nltk_data/tokenizers && cd /usr/share/nltk_data/tokenizers && unzip -q /whl/punkt.zip; cd /repo
timeout 600 bash bin/run.sh configs/cdr/relex/cdr_2500 '' 2>&1 | tail -40"

docker run --rm -v /tmp/bran:/repo -v /tmp/whl:/whl:ro -w /repo -e CDR_IE_ROOT=/repo -e PYTHONPATH=/repo tensorflow/tensorflow:1.0.1 bash -c "
pip install -q --no-index --no-deps /whl/nltk-3.4.5.zip /whl/termcolor-1.1.0.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1
timeout 600 bash bin/run.sh configs/cdr/relex/cdr_2500 '' 2>&1 | tail -30"

install.log_tail: 仓库无 requirements.txt。TF 1.0.1 镜像自带 numpy/tensorflow;缺 nltk(+punkt)与 termcolor。镜像内的旧 pip(Python 2.7.6, 无 TLS1.2)无法访问 PyPI('No matching distribution found for nltk'),改为在宿主机 pip download 后以 --no-index 本地安装成功。注意 six-1.17 会破坏镜像内 pip,改用 --no-deps 保留自带 six-1.10。
